'library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#31333F"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "#808495"),
      text = element_text(colour = "#31333F"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#E6E9EF"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)

# KGV-Verteilung pro Sektor als Small Multiples (log. Skala)
p <- dataset |>
  filter(KGV > 0, Sektor != "Unbekannt") |>
  mutate(Sektor = reorder(Sektor, KGV, FUN = median)) |>
  ggplot(aes(KGV)) +
  geom_density(fill = "#83C9FF", colour = "#0068C9", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(
    data = \(d) summarise(d, median_kgv = median(KGV), .by = Sektor),
    aes(xintercept = median_kgv),
    colour = "#FF2B2B"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(5, 10, 20, 50, 100)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Sektor), ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "KGV-Verteilung pro Sektor",
    subtitle = "Dichte auf log. Skala, rote Linie = Median",
    x = "KGV",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8)
  )

print(p)
'
